name: @facet/openapi-importer
description: Hostile-input OpenAPI ingestion and normalization service for FACET.

scripts.format: prettier --write src test package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json eslint.config.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src test package.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json eslint.config.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
